starters.name: Safe defaults
starters.summary: Blocks agents from reading environment variables; unknown publishers default to block.

starters.name: Package firewall
starters.summary: Blocks known compromised packages and sets new publishers to review in the defaults.

starters.name: Secrets guard
starters.summary: Blocks agents from reading environment variables or files into a prompt.

starters.name: MCP server guard
starters.summary: Blocks agents from starting MCP servers until you narrow or remove the rule.

starters.name: Team baseline
starters.summary: A shared floor for every device: compromised packages and secret reads are blocked outright.

starters.name: Blank
starters.summary: No rules. Guard asks at the device and you add rules as you learn what your agents do.

rendered.safe-defaults:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://hol.org/schema/policy/v1alpha1
# Edit the rules, then run: hol-guard policy test guard-policy.yaml
apiVersion: guard.hashgraphonline.com/v1alpha1
kind: GuardPolicy
metadata:
  id: policy.safe-defaults
  name: "Safe defaults"
  revision: 1
spec:
  defaults:
    mode: prompt
    defaultAction: warn
    unknownPublisherAction: block
  rules:
    - id: rule-safe-defaults-env-secrets
      description: "Agents may not read environment variables, where API keys usually live."
      enabled: true
      effect: block
      match:
        tools:
          - prompt-env-read
      lifetime:
        mode: permanent
      provenance:
        source: builder
        createdAt: 2026-01-02T03:04:05Z
  x-hol.tests:
    - id: test-safe-defaults-env-secrets
      name: "Codex reads environment variables"
      event:
        harness: codex
        tool: prompt-env-read
      expect:
        effect: block
        ruleId: rule-safe-defaults-env-secrets
    - id: test-safe-defaults-fallthrough-package
      name: "An unlisted package falls through to the defaults"
      event:
        harness: codex
        artifact: pkg:npm/left-pad
      expect:
        effect: default
